audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state reference mapping and development-only RNA-ATAC integration

stabmap_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint; only declared outer-training reference and bridge matrices

interpretation: StabMap has no checkpoint-corpus contamination, but the unwrapped function is query-dependent: it centers and scales every supplied dataset, constructs a topology containing all datasets, may use intermediate datasets to fit projections, and finally recenters the combined embedding. A held-back query is eligible only through a wrapper that fixes training references and bridges, makes every held dataset a terminal leaf, disables native scaling, uses frozen upstream transforms, and anchors final coordinates to training references alone. StabMap remains latent-only for RNA-conditioned ATAC.
remaining_blockers: Implement a leakage-safe wrapper with training-only references and bridges, terminal query leaves, scale.center=false, scale.scale=false, projectAll=false, and frozen upstream transforms.

Replace combined reference-plus-query centering with a training-reference-only origin and prove adding, removing, or permuting query donors cannot move reference coordinates, head parameters, prototypes, or neighbour indices.

Freeze the connected training topology, bridge construction, feature namespaces/intersections, reference features/scores, PCA or LDA dimensions, projection coefficients, common/native heads, k policy, and five seeds.
For GSE296875, validate same-nucleus joins before constructing one stacked RNA-ATAC bridge matrix. For GSE244832, never stack different aliquots as one cell.
Keep labels_list NULL in the common lane. Any training-label LDA or classifyEmbedding result is a separately declared native lane and cannot use held labels.
Validate StabMap 1.6.0 under a frozen Bioconductor 3.23 environment, recording sessionInfo, sparse/dense equivalence, deterministic PCA and neighbour search, serial/parallel tolerance, and memory.
Export projection components as plain local matrices and manifests; do not accept external serialized R objects.
Prove GSE289173 is a terminal RNA-only query and cannot influence any fitted reference component before prediction hashes are committed.
sealed_champion_eligibility: blocked_pending_terminal_query_training_reference_centering_bridge_runtime_and_leakage_fixtures; eligible in principle for sealed cell-state mapping only
